Name: More Collections - Armory and Attire
Author: scayze
Description:
[b]How it works[/b]
[list][*]In the collection page in the menu two new tabs are added by clicking the down arrow
[*]One with weapons
[*]One with clothing that are divided between hats, shirts, pants, shoes and rings
[*]You can also go back to the existing collection pages again by clicking the arrow up
[*]When hovering over the items you'll see the descriptions and buffs if applicable (couldn't screenshot while showing this)[/list]

[b]Extra configuration options[/b]
[list][*]You can disable the clothing you can get from heart-events. This is enabled by default
[*]You can change the order of weapon and clothing items, or exclude/include items. Items that aren't obtainable according to the wiki are excluded by default and the order is carefully crafted by my gf ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/looooor?gameId=1303]looooor[/url]﻿), but feel free to change it[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list][*]When resizing the window while the collection page is open, the game crashes (but who doesn't play full screen, am I right...)
[*]Some of the dyable clothing silhouettes are more ~revealing~ than others because of layering. We didn't find this a problem personally
[*]Some of the hats can overlap a little
[*]Controller doesn't work with the arrows[/list]

[b]FAQ[/b]
[list][*]What happens to custom weapons/clothing?
﻿They will probably be added at the end of the collections, but as said before: the display order can be changed in the configuration file
﻿Note: this is not properly tested because we don't use custom weapons/clothing[/list]

[list][*]Does the collection page know what weapons/clothing I own?
Yes, it scans chests, dressers, your inventory and the clothes you're wearing[/list]

[list][*]Is the wedding ring always available in the collection?
No, it's only available when you're hosting a multiplayer save[/list]

[list][*]Is this mod Open Source?
yes: [url=https://github.com/scayze/MoreCollections]https://github.com/scayze/MoreCollections[/url][/list]
